items.name: Readability
items.evidence: The change is four lines and matches the surrounding style. The comment "# Re-attach auth to netloc" says what the line does, and the names come from the existing code.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: It is a minimal local fix inside prepend_scheme_if_needed and reuses the auth field that parse_url already returns. It adds no helpers or dead code, and nothing was left over from the agent's scratch experiments.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: "(netloc or '')" guards against a None netloc, and the block is gated on "if auth:". There are no swallowed errors and no magic constants.

items.name: prepend_scheme_if_needed public behaviour unchanged otherwise
items.name_zh: prepend_scheme_if_needed 其他公开行为不变
items.evidence: The signature is unchanged. URLs without auth skip the new block, so their behaviour is the same. Auth comes from parse_url and is re-attached verbatim, with no urllib3 or Python-version special-casing. Hidden tests pass (P2P 185/185).
